file_roles.evidence: Adds get_hadoop_dir_for_stack_version and drops the upgrade_stack_only flag: a helper needed by the new versioned-path logic in hive_server_upgrade.py, not a corrected defect.
Extracts is_hdp_stack_greater_or_equal_to(version, compare) from the existing method with identical behaviour; supporting extraction.
Adds COMMAND_DOWNGRADE_FROM_VERSION and puts it into the command params in four places; plumbing so the script can see the downgrade-source version.
New findLastUpgradeForCluster query method, only used to feed the new downgrade_from_version param.
Adds NamedQuery UpgradeEntity.findLatestForCluster used by the new DAO method; supporting plumbing.
Adds m_downgradeFromVersion field with getter/setter; carrier for the new param.

stop() no longer calls pre_upgrade_deregister() during rolling restart; start() now calls post_upgrade_deregister() after hive_service start. This fixes the wrong order the report describes (deregister before new HS2 is up).

pre_upgrade_deregister renamed post_upgrade_deregister and the hive --version / deregister path is now computed from the exact versioned /usr/hdp/<ver>/hive/bin path (_get_hive_execute_path), matching the report's second point about using the HDP versioned path.
Adds downgrade_from_version = default('/commandParams/downgrade_from_version') param read; adaptation needed by the real fix in hive_server_upgrade.py.

rationale: Behavioural bug is an ordering and path-selection error in the HiveServer2 scripts: stop() deregistered before the new server started, and hive --version used the already-switched current path. The Java/Python common changes only carry the downgrade-from version to the scripts.
notes: Java plumbing could arguably be causal if missing downgrade_from_version is viewed as the defect; I treated it as support for the script fix.
